output.title: Show HN: Self-hostable no-code internal tools on top of your Postgres — schema in, working admin panel out
output.body:
I built stackbuilt because we kept getting asked to build internal admin panels, and Retool's pricing and data residency became a problem. It connects to your Postgres, reads the schema, and scaffolds CRUD interfaces, dashboards, and approval flows in under a minute. It self-hosts with a single Docker command — data never leaves your network. RBAC is included in the free tier, and only builders pay; viewers are free forever.

Built in Go and React, it’s running in production at a 200-person logistics company. The core workflow — schema to working UI in under 60 seconds — is shown unedited in the demo video. Postgres-only for now; no MySQL or REST sources yet. No audit log export.

Would love feedback on the scaffolding accuracy, UX for non-technical builders, and what integrations would make it stickier.
